**Subject: Re: Broken on arrival AGAIN (Order #58213)**

Hi Jordan,

I'm so sorry your kettle arrived with a cracked lid again. After four years as a customer, you deserve far better, and I completely understand your frustration.

I'd like to make this right by sending a replacement kettle at no cost, and we'll upgrade the packaging so it arrives safely. You won't need to return the damaged one. If you could reply with a quick photo of the cracked lid, I'll get the replacement out right away.

Thank you for sticking with us, and again, I'm truly sorry.

Warm regards,
[Your name]

*(About 100 words.)*

draft a reply to this customer email. apologize, but don't promise a refund, offer a replacement instead. keep it under 120 words and friendly
